resource.description: The name of the resource this response is from.

status.description: The status of the response i.e. success or failed.

response.description: Response object with the details of the call recordings

call_recording_id.description: Unique ID assigned to identify each call recording.

type.description: The type of call recording. Only `voice_call` supported at the moment.

user_id.description: If the call recording is assigned to a user, this property lists the user_id.

created_date.description: The timestamp when the call recording was created.

file.description: Details of the call recording file object such as the size, download URL and so on.

type.description: File type such as mp3, etc.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the download link was created.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the download link will expire.

voice_call_details.description: Details of the call that was recorded.

from.description: 'The entity that initiated the call. Can be a PSTN number, a user, etc.

to.description: The entity to which the call was placed.

codec.description: The codec that was use to connect the call.

usage_record_id.description: Unique ID assigned to this call record (CDR)

start_time.description: The time when the call started.

end_time.description: The time when the call ended.

call_length.description: The duration of the call in seconds.

from_type.description: The type of entity that initiated the call. For example `user`, `phonenumber`.

from_name.description: If a user initiated the call, their name is listed here otherwise it shows the phone number of the source.

caller_id.description: The caller ID that was displayed to the recipient.

to_type.description: The entity that answered the call such as `user`, `phonenumber`, etc.

to_name.description: A name or phone number identifying the destination.

to_orig.description: A unique identifier for the destination.

summary.description:
The Sonetel AI generated call summary.
If this object is not included in the response, it indicates that the summary was not requested or possible

Call-summary.title: Call-summary
Call-summary.description: Call summary generated by Sonetel AI

text_id.description:
The unique `text_id` of the call summary.
The text_id can be used to retrieve details of the summary from the [Sonetel Text manager](reference/13_ai_textmanager.yaml)

file_id.description:
The unique `file_id` of the call recording in the [Sonetel file manager](reference/15_ai_filemanager.yaml)
File_id is used by Sonetel AI services as a reference to the call recording for generating summaries.

about.description: A short Sonetel AI generated string that identifies what the call is about.

score.description: A score(1 to 5) assigned by Sonetel AI to the call recording based on an analysis of the call.

status.description:
The status of the call summary generation

`not_requested`: The summary has not yet been not_requested

`in_progress`: The summary generation is in progress

`ready`: The summary is ready. The summary can be fetched using the `text_id` from the [text manager](reference/13_ai_textmanager.yaml)

`failed`: The summary was requested and has failed. It is not possible to summarize this recording.

`retry`: The summary was requested and failed. The summary can be requested again.

error_code.description: An error code that identifies the last error during summary generation.

error_date.description: The date and time when the last error occured during summary generation
